about.title: InayaBridge: connecting patients and caregivers, everywhere.
about.overview: Healthcare should be accessible to everyone. InayaBridge was born from a simple observation: in many regions, seeing a doctor is still a challenge. So we decided to build the tool we wished already existed — a free, human, and connected platform.
about.vision1: We dream of a world where health is not limited by distance, technology, or means. A world where a simple connection is enough to receive help, care, and listening.
about.vision2: With InayaBridge, we want to build a bridge between patients and doctors, between technology and humanity, between needs and solutions.
about.vision3: It’s an ambitious vision, but it starts here — with you.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.contact: Can’t find the answer to your question? Feel free to reach out to our

items.q: Is the platform free for patients?
items.a: Yes, InayaBridge is and will always remain completely free for patients. No credit card, no subscription, no commitment.

items.q: Do doctors need to pay to use the platform?
items.a: No, all features are free in the current version (V1). In future versions, advanced tools (statistics, exports, API) will be offered in paid plans.
Consultations use end-to-end encryption. Your calls are neither recorded nor shared. Our priority: medical confidentiality.

items.q: Can the platform be accessed on mobile?
items.a: Yes, InayaBridge works from any modern browser on desktop, tablet, or smartphone. No download required.

items.q: How can I join as a doctor?
items.a: Simply create a professional account. You can start consulting as soon as your profile is validated. It’s simple, fast, and without hidden fees.
